# AI Voice Agency

> 3AM. GOOGLE WAS LISTENING. Every missed call hands the job to the next name on the map

AVA is a done-for-you AI receptionist service from AI Voice Agency, based in Kewaskum, Wisconsin. AVA answers business phone lines 24/7, qualifies callers, books appointments into the business calendar, and sends text confirmations to the caller and the owner.

Last reviewed: 2026-09-28

## Pricing

- Pricing: Starter is $497 per month plus $497 setup, Growth is $997 per month plus $1,500 setup, Operations plans start at $1,997 per month and are custom-scoped.
- Voice minutes bill by usage.
- Starter is month-to-month.

## The questions operators ask

- AVA picks up in one ring, any hour of the day.
- Then it does the receptionist's real job: it books the appointment into your calendar or routes the call by your rules.
- The caller gets a confirmation text. You get a summary the moment it lands.
- We launch AVA on your existing line, and your forwarding rules decide what it takes: every call, after-hours only, or just the overflow when your team is already on the phone.
- Does AVA replace my receptionist or dispatcher? No. AVA covers what they physically can't: 2 AM, Sunday, both lines ringing at once, and the calls that come in while they're already helping someone.
- It follows the fallback rule you chose: transfer straight to your cell, take a message and text it to you, or schedule a callback.
- AVA is an AI assistant. Demo calls are scripted samples using AVA's demo voice and sample data.
